instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct subordinate conjunction.

atoms.a: ssml: She loves her sister because she always took care of her.
atoms.b: She loves her sister ((++because if when that)) she always took care of her.

atoms.b: I will call you ((because if ++when that)) I get home.
